header.title: Online Payments
header.subtitle: Connect your Stripe account to send payment links — and set up the methods your clinic accepts at the front desk.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.description: Get paid by patients through payment links in your currency ({{currency}}), with cards and local methods. The account is yours: funds settle directly to it and Stripe charges its own fees.
features: Disputes & receipts in the Stripe dashboard
stripe.onboardingNote: Your Stripe setup isn't finished yet. Pick up where you left off — it only takes a few minutes.
stripe.disabledNote: Stripe has restricted payments on this account. Open the Stripe dashboard to resolve the pending requirements.
stripe.activeFootnote: Payment links are available in Finance for any pending charge.
stripe.inactiveFootnote: No Stripe? No problem — record card machine, cash and bank transfer payments directly in Finance.
stripe.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect the Stripe account? Payment links will no longer be offered. The account itself keeps existing on Stripe.

toasts.onboardingIncomplete: Stripe setup still incomplete. Resume anytime.

manualMethods.title: Methods accepted at the front desk
manualMethods.subtitle: Your clinic is free to agree on payment with each patient. Enable the methods you accept — they show up when recording payments in Finance.
manualMethods.footnote: These methods are manual records — the payment happens outside the platform and you log it at the front desk.
